## IGramstaxCacheKeyboardRef type

`cacheKeyboard` slot: a path-ref to a `Map` subclass, an entries array, or a plain object (entries via `Object.entries`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxCacheKeyboardRef = IGramstaxPathRef | Array<[string, unknown]> | Record<string, unknown>;
```
**References:** [IGramstaxPathRef](./gramstax.igramstaxpathref.md)

## Remarks

Four accepted shapes (enforced by the loader): - a module path string resolving to a `Map` subclass - an `{override: {module, export?, args?}}` ref resolving to a `Map` subclass - an entries array (`Array<[string, unknown]>`<!-- -->) used as `new Map(entries)` - a plain object whose entries seed the map via `Object.entries`

## Example


```typescript
const fromPath: IGramstaxCacheKeyboardRef = `./src/keyboard-cache.ts`
const entries: IGramstaxCacheKeyboardRef = [[`main:en`, {text: `Main`}]]
const plain: IGramstaxCacheKeyboardRef = {[`main:en`]: {text: `Main`}}
```
